thread:
Claire (partnerships): heads-up: we need to coordinate a breaking change across partner SDKs — versioned client auth token format will move from plain token -> scoped JWT. Enforcement date proposed: 2026-01-20. 10-week runway. Need marketplace vendor notice, SDK adapters, and SI playbook.
Arjun (eng): ok. server-side we'll accept old tokens with a compat flag but log `auth_plain_deprecated`. We can add an endpoint `/auth/upgrade` to mint scoped JWTs for partners who call in.
Tess (product): partners will want a clear mapping table and a non-breaking migration path. propose partner preview w/ sandbox, migration CLI, and a partner-only SDK prerelease.
Ned (legal): checking contract language — most partners require 30 days for breaking auth changes; 10-week runway gives room. I'll flag any enterprise terms that require longer notice.
Ravi (platform): runtime ops plan: gateway will accept both tokens until enforcement. we'll emit header `X-RW-Auth-Mode: jwt` when JWT used. recommend canary ap-south first to surface mobile/SI edgecases. runbook RNW-602 created.
Mika (devex): I can publish small adapters: js + python wrappers that introspect token and call `/auth/upgrade` to get JWT. plan: npm/pypi prereleases and a tiny CLI `rw-auth-upgrade`. ETA for alpha: 2025-11-25.
MarketWatchBot: @Claire created issue RNW-6100 "Auth token migration: plain -> scoped JWT for partners" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-6100
Arjun (eng): telemetry: will add `auth_migration_attempt` events and daily export of partners still using plain tokens. also will provide a lightweight API that returns `token_format` for a client id so partners can programmatically check.
Claire (partnerships): action items: Partnerships to ping top 30 partners + marketplace vendors on Dec 1. Tess to draft partner FAQ + migration checklist by Nov 20. Mika to publish adapters alpha Nov 25. Ravi to enable canary Dec 5. Ned to confirm legal notice timing by Nov 15. Arjun to provision telemetry dashboard Nov 18.
Tess (product): draft FAQ posted: http://go/redwood/partner-auth-jwt  includes token mapping, examples, rollback steps, and SI migration notes. Please review.
Mika (devex): adapter usage example (JS): `const rw = require('@redwood/auth-adapter'); await rw.upgradeToken(oldToken, {clientId}); // returns {jwt, expiresAt}` will include auto-refresh helpers for long-running services.
Ravi (platform): canary plan: enable ap-south Dec 5, eu-central Dec 12, us-west Dec 19, global Jan 15. enforcement Jan 20 -> gateway returns 401 unless JWT or upgrade performed.
Ned (legal): flagged two marketplace partners with custom SLAs — partnerships to do one-off notices and confirm they can upgrade. I'll join outreach emails.
Arjun (eng): also note for hardware partners: some edge devices can't reach our `/auth/upgrade` endpoint directly. propose we allow partner-admins to mint JWTs via partner portal or marketplace orchestration flow. Devex to document.
Mika (devex): will add portal button to mint scoped JWTs and include a short video demo. also publishing lightweight C helper for constrained devices.
Claire (partnerships): timeline summary: Nov 15 legal ok, Nov 20 FAQ + checklist, Nov 25 adapters alpha, Dec 1 partner/vendor ping + sandbox, Dec 5 canary ap-south, Dec 12 canary eu-central, Dec 19 canary us-west, Jan 15 global rollout, Jan 20 enforcement.
Arjun (eng): will tag RNW-6100 with owners and add daily partner impact export for outreach.
Tess (product): owners: partnerships=Claire, eng=Arjun, devex=Mika, platform=Ravi, legal=Ned, docs=Tess. please update RNW-6100 with owner + ETA.
Claire (partnerships): thanks everyone — partnerships will prep escalation contacts for top SIs and marketplace vendors and schedule partner office hours. :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
